I am farming here in Tabora for many years now. This plot of mine is about six hectares and I grow mixed crops together, intercropping like my father taught me. Chemical fertilizer is too expensive and the agro-dealer is far, so I rely on the manure from my cattle and goats to keep the soil strong. For such a big plot, me and my wife and the older children we work together, but I must also hire some young men from the village to help with weeding and harvest.
